vision: To help children thrive, grow in independence, and shine in their own way. Vathsalya envisages bringing clinicians, therapists, educators, and parents into close collaboration—ensuring that interventions remain effective well beyond the therapy setting. This integrated approach combines therapy with education and life skills, focusing on discovering and nurturing each child's unique abilities so they can flourish with greater independence.
mission: Vathsalya Child Neuronurture Centre creates individualized, holistic circles of care that support each child's developmental journey while strengthening family confidence. We channel clinical excellence and evidence-based expertise into compassionate services for neurodivergent children and their families, bridging research-backed interventions with real-world family support.
values: Compassion at the heart of every interaction
